cache_efficiency.note: Net cache value includes both sides: 1h writes at 2x, 5m writes at 1.25x, and reads at 0.1x versus the same input processed uncached. Unknown-TTL writes make the verdict explicitly unavailable; reads alone are never called a saving. Values are base-input-token equivalents, not Max quota.
